name: Common Pleco (Hypostomus plecostomus)
description: Frequently sold as a small juvenile, grows to ~40 cm and produces an enormous bioload. Only suitable in 600L+ tanks. Substring 'pleco' fires both the bottom depth-band and algae-grazer feeding heuristics; explicit `bioloadClass: high` overrides the size-based default and warns F7.2's stocking rules that this is a heavy-waste species despite ostensibly being labelled an algae-eater.
